Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Shape, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n": ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20
    Case 1
        ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20: ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n"
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n": ws.ChartObjects.Add 100, 10, 100, 60
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n": ws.Range("B2").AddComment "n": ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20: ws.ChartObjects.Add 100, 10, 100, 60
    Case 4
        ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20: ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n": ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20: ws.Range("B2").AddComment "n"
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n": ws.Range("A1").Comment.Delete: ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20
    Case 6
        ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20: ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n": ws.Range("A1").Comment.Delete: ws.Range("B2").AddComment "n": ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n": ws.Shapes.AddFormControl xlButtonControl, 10, 100, 60, 20: ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20: ws.Range("B2").AddComment "n"
    Case 8
        ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20: ws.Shapes.AddFormControl xlButtonControl, 10, 100, 60, 20: ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n": ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 20
    Case 9
        ws.Shapes.AddFormControl xlButtonControl, 10, 100, 60, 20: ws.Shapes.AddFormControl xlButtonControl, 10, 100, 60, 20: ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n"
    End Select
    For Each sh In ws.Shapes: s = s & "|" & sh.Name & "," & sh.ID & "," & sh.Type: Next
    Tried = "ok " & s
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 9
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
